name: dsh-think-fold
description: Expands the row that is running and folds it back when it settles. A running turn keeps its procedure in one height-capped window that scrolls itself, and the segments a mid-turn reply splits it into share that single height budget; when the turn ends it merges into the built-in finished header, leaving only the final answer. 正在跑的那一行自动展开、跑完自动收起；跑着的一轮把过程收进一个限高窗口，被旁白切成好几段时共用同一份高度，轮结束并进官方那条「已完成」，只留最终回复。
author: Citrusrr
